safety: This build has NO real executor. All apply/undo/reset operations modify only SQLite simulation records. Never unlink/move/kill/control services/edit startup outside app-owned data.

api.GET /api/tasks: {tasks}; latest 15 durable tasks, current plan and event summaries
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}: {task}; status, goal, scopes, versioned plan, latest result, feedback, events, briefing, last_public_reply, investigation_notice and execution; plan/items and advice include host-owned provenance; previous advice identity independent of new plan
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/continue: {} -> {task,job_id}; continue a stopped or completed investigation
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/feedback: {message?,keep_ids?} -> {task,job_id}; save user intent, invalidate plan, investigate again
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/approve: {version,ids} -> {task,job_id}; explicit selection of exact plan, simulation apply/verify then stop with per-item results; later investigation requires explicit continue, no automatic model request during cleanup
api.POST /api/check: legacy compatibility only; no standalone UI entry; fixed known caches and partial inventories
api.GET /api/recommendations: {items:[original item + advice],groups,summary}; cached current model result or local rules, per-advice provenance; failed same-token reanalysis may retain previous valid model cache with analysis_notice
api.POST /api/recommendations/analyze: {} -> {items,groups,summary}; structured model advice if configured, rule fallback otherwise
api.POST /api/plan: {ids,action?,selection_mode?,snapshots?:{id:signature}} -> frozen plan; rejects stale provided signatures before approval
api.GET /api/history: {history,attempts,attempts_has_more}; recent100 durable batches, receipt-backed operation_group(task_id,plan_version), per-item current recovery/verification projection, and recent100 non-success ordinary attempts; no journal rewrites
api.POST /api/duplicates: legacy explicit-catalog-files verifier {ids:<=100} -> {groups,warnings,bytes_read}; local SHA-256 with512MiB default read budget, no model or automatic deletion
api.POST /api/duplicates/scan: {paths:1..8 absolute local directories,max_entries?:1..100000(default25000),max_depth?:1..32(default16),max_bytes?:1..8589934592(default2147483648)} -> {job_id}; independent read-only size grouping then full SHA-256, cancel/progress through existing job routes; malformed request rejected synchronously, no readable roots causes failed job duplicate_scan_failed, some unavailable roots yields partial result. No LLM, main-catalog publication, score, plan or delete action
api.GET /api/files: {task_id?,offset?,limit?:1..100,query?,scope?,risk?,revision?,view?:all|suggestions|tree,parent_id?,kind?:all|file|directory|startup|service|process|software,rating?:all|high|low|neutral|unrated|skipped|no_advice|1..5} -> bounded observed-only page with assessment_revision,selection_revision,groups,coverage,breadcrumbs and per-row assessment/can_logical_select/can_auto_select/action/action_label/action_effect/action_unavailable_reason. Without task_id remains file/directory only; task_id restricts known/action scope, task suggestions only current-task direct explicit/skipped/no_advice records. Application tasks use suggestions/all flat, reject tree, no path inheritance; service details include state/state_label/start_mode, process details PID. Scope filter applies to files. Combined revision includes model assessment changes; stale revision409 Version0.18 shares the exact query/view/parent/rating/scope/risk/kind predicate with row selection; tree is current parent layer. Ancestors shown solely as filter-navigation paths are navigation_only and cannot be selected; a matching partial real directory may be logically selected, never presumed fully executable.
api.GET /api/providers: {presets,protocols,checked_at}; documented presets, no live vendor guarantee
api.POST /api/tasks/analyze: {section,ids? OR query?/scope?/risk?/kind?,depth?,goal?} -> {task,job_id}; frozen analysis selection, no execution approval
api.POST /api/developer: {enabled?:bool,clear?:bool}; defaults off, captures subsequent requests only
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/facts: {offset?,limit?:1..20,ids?:comma-separated fact IDs up to12} -> {items,total,offset,limit,has_more}; historical observations with scope/source/time/recheck rule
api.GET /api/skills/{id}: {cursor?} -> flat versioned content, sha256, sources, budget, next_cursor; allowlisted resources only
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/direct-plan: {ids:1..500,action OR actions:{every id:action},snapshots?} -> {task,plan}; exactly one uniform action or complete per-ID actions map, identity/action/scope preflight and user-origin versioned plan with action_groups; approval remains separate existing approve route
api.POST /api/ui-preferences: allowlisted preference subset -> {preferences}; persisted separately from model settings/capture
api.GET /api/icon: {id,v?} -> local image bytes, X-Panxu-Icon-Status:ready|pending|fallback; existing catalog IDs only; no arbitrary path; bounded private memory cache and async extraction
api.POST /api/preferences: {custom_instructions:string} -> {preferences,settings}; merges only shared model-independent preference, preserves connection and key
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream: {stream,volatile:true}; bounded sanitized public cumulative reply, never tool arguments or approval
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/stream/events: SSE default data:{stream}; 4 concurrent connections,25s lifetime, snapshots/keepalive; resume by epoch+sequence
api.POST /api/updates/check: {} -> {status,current_version,latest_version,release_url,message,checked_at,source,code,cached}; explicit manual read-only release discovery; current private source not_configured, no network; never downloads or installs
api.POST /api/assessments/select: {task_id?:string|null,category?:all|high|low|neutral|unrated|skipped|no_advice|1..5,mode?:manual|automatic,include_inherited?:bool,query?,scope?,risk?,kind?,view?:all|suggestions|tree,parent_id?,representation?:roots|rows,cursor?,limit?:1..500,revision?,selection_revision?} -> selection_batch. roots default preserves compatibility; rows uses the same filtered visible-row query as GETfiles, across cursor pages without physical directory expansion/coalescing; tree only current parent layer, navigation-only/protected/unsupported rows excluded with counts. Cursor binds all filters/view/parent/representation/revisions. Missing/null task_id is manual global files-only, never applications; automatic requires source task. UI offers exact1..5/skipped/unrated/no_advice/all rather than grouped high/low. Each page<=500, counts.total_targets covers all eligible matching rows, no operation or model call.
api.POST /api/assessments/compile: {task_id:string|null,selected_ids,excluded_ids,snapshots:{every positive and negative id:signature},revision,selection_revision,cursor?,limit?:1..500} -> selection_batch plus logical,warnings. All six logical keys remain required; null task_id restricts global file/directory inventory, source task keeps its known/action scope. <=5000 explicit rules, <=500 physical targets per response; nearest path exceptions only for files, exact IDs for applications. Validate identities/actions/revisions and observed-only coverage, no scan/model/operation.
api.POST /api/assessments/plan: {task_id:string|null,selected_ids,excluded_ids,snapshots,revision,selection_revision} -> {task,plan,picked_ids,selection,source_task_id}; compile under shared lock and freeze <=500 actual targets, full logical counts/remaining stay in selection. Null task_id permits global files-only, a source task permits only its file/background/software action scope. Separate approval; remaining draft may need recheck after catalog change, no seamless all-batch promise. Legacy four-key {ids:1..500,snapshots,revision,action:delete} unchanged with stricter advice eligibility. No model or automatic approval.
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/execution: {} -> {execution:null|execution_state}; bounded current simulation batch status and per-item results, not task investigation progress
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/execution/pause: {version:int} -> {execution}; cooperative pause between item commits, currently admitted atomic commit may finish; stale version409
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/execution/resume: {version:int} -> {execution}; continue current paused simulation batch, not investigation reanalysis or replay after restart
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/execution/cancel: {version:int} -> {execution}; stop uncommitted remaining items, retain committed receipts; cancellation is not undo
api.GET /api/cleanup-tools: {items,categories,total,registry_version,simulation_only}; compact shared registry of 48 capabilities, not proof every application is installed or every tool has a complete reader/live executor
api.GET /api/cleanup-tools/{id}: detail, parameter fields, impact, recovery, fixed application/settings entries with entry_id,available,reason,browser? and implementation capabilities; sources remain developer references, no official-document action
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/inspect: {tool_id,parameters?}; fixed read-only memory/power/volume or bounded metadata; presentation:{kind,summary,status,complete,metrics:[{key,label,value,unit,denominator?,denominator_label?}],items:[{label,value,unit?}],warnings,recycle?}; evidence retained. Missing required location returns needs_input; unknown never replaced with zero. Cooperative 600 entries/0.15 seconds/depth3 for cache metadata; no contents, link traversal, hydration or CLI cleanup
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/prepare: {tool_id,parameters?,source?}; persist frozen simulation plan; navigation and feedback not approval
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/prepare-many: {items:[{tool_id,parameters?}],source?}; deduplicate identical tools, reject conflicting variants; freeze one plan
api.GET /api/cleanup-plans/{id}: durable frozen plan and result; interrupted work is not replayed
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/execute: {plan_id,version}; exact version confirmation, shared ActionRuntime, virtual receipt verification; real reclaimed bytes 0
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/cancel: {plan_id,version}; cancel review or request safe-stage cancellation
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/undo: {plan_id}; undo only virtual receipts, append truthful feedback
api.GET /api/cleanup-tools/history: {history}; durable specialist plans and verified results shown with existing operation records
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/open-settings: {tool_id,index?,parameters?,source?}; host re-resolves fixed entry_id to absolute registered program plus fixed args or fixed system URI; status opened/applied:false, no model-supplied path/URL/command. Recycle Bin uses Shell namespace; browser availability per browser, never launches wsreset as passive open
api.GET /api/specialist: ?item_id&signature?&task_id? -> host-resolved current tool/extra suggestion link and original parent source; no execution
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/specialist-answer: {suggestion_id,option_id,version?}; persist versioned answer, return validated optional tool reference; never execute or request model
api.GET /api/file-browser/drives: read-only fixed drive list with capacity, breadcrumbs and explicit subtree_complete:false; no recursive scan/model call
api.GET /api/file-browser: {path,cursor?,limit?:1..100(default50),refresh?:bool,task_id?}; direct children only, shared catalog identity, assessment/coverage, breadcrumbs, signature-bound expiring cursor. LRU8 directories,5000 cached entries/directory,120s idle TTL; per advance256 entries/0.15s cooperative default. Directory size may be unknown; current-layer complete is never subtree complete or LLM coverage; no link traversal or cloud hydration
api.GET /api/recovery/summary: simulation-only dedicated retention summary; logical_bytes and explicit unknown_size_count, never actual physical occupancy or reclaimed bytes; independent of Windows Recycle Bin
api.GET /api/recovery: {page?,limit?:1..100,status?:retained|restored|purged|all,volume?}; bounded dedicated retention records; no automatic expiry or real file movement
api.GET /api/recovery/plans/{id}: durable frozen restore/purge plan; simulation only
api.POST /api/recovery/prepare: {ids,action:restore|purge}; freeze exact currently eligible dedicated retention records; no operation approval or real I/O
api.POST /api/recovery/execute: {plan_id,confirmation}; separate exact confirmation for restore or permanent purge intent; simulation records only. Purged records cannot be resurrected by legacy undo/reset
api.GET /api/agent-budget: {model_requests,tool_calls}; per-turn hard limits, soft model hints
api.POST /api/agent-budget: partial {model_requests?,tool_calls?} -> saved flat budget; strict integer bounds
api.POST /api/user-tools/inspect: {tool_id,version?}|{draft_id} -> bounded read-only run with first50 matches
api.POST /api/user-tools/prepare: {run_id,ids?,excluded_ids?} -> existing frozen file plan or specialist_plan; not approval
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/work/{job_id}: task-owned durable read-only background work; paths/results not dumped
api.POST /api/tasks/{id}/work/{job_id}/cance: {} -> cancel remaining read-only work, keep existing results
api.GET /api/tasks/{id}/diagnostics/{snapsho: paged diagnostic detail with original time, status, coverage and evidence refs
api.GET /api/cleanup-tools/assessments: {query?,category?,volume?}; static 48-tool catalog plus bounded cached assessments; no OS/model I/O. Unknown is not zero; fixed definition separate from current observations and builtin/llm recommendation.
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/assess: {tool_id,parameters?,refresh?}; read-only bounded inspection, exact parameter identity, inspection_id/signature, 96-entry cache with 60-second freshness. Logical bytes are not actual savings; partial/subset observations cannot claim full cleanup size.
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/assessments/summ: {items:[{tool_id,parameters?,inspection_id?}]}; cache-only summary up to64 references; unknown coverage and overlapping roots/file identities are not summed as confirmed reclaimed space.
api.POST /api/cleanup-tools/prepare-selectio: {items:[{tool_id,parameters,inspection_id}],source?};1-40 fresh checked executable nonoverlapping operations through existing prepare_many/ActionRuntime. No model call or real mutation.
api.POST /api/tasks/tool-analysis: {items:[{tool_id,parameters,inspection_id}],goal?,reanalyze?,skip_analyzed?};1-64 exact cached diagnostic snapshots, task-private kind cleanup_tool, scope_kind/analysis.section cleanup_tools; existing agent job/facts/advice loop. No file catalog insertion, parameter changes or execution. Public cleanup_tool_targets retains frozen assessments and genuine advice/provenance, including stale historical results.

mutations: Require X-CSRF-Token from bootstrap. Errors are JSON {error,code}. Relative same-origin fetch only. Input limits apply.
summary: {total_items,visible_items,simulated_items,logical_bytes,simulated_bytes,process_memory_bytes,by_kind,source,mode}. Real disks separate; no simulated_bytes shown as actual freed space.
source: empty | local; normal startup contains no synthetic examples; fixtures require developer_fixtures=True at server creation
advice: {group:'recommended'|'personal'|'keep'|'review',title,purpose,reason,impact,impact_rating?:int1..5|null,auto_select,suggested_action,origin:'rule'|'model',needs_user_choice}; personal and unknown files never auto_select; impact_rating never changes selection or operation eligibility
history: list batches {id,created_at,status:'simulated'|'partially_undone'|'undone',item_count,estimated_bytes,items:[{id,name,path,kind,action,status}],mode}; recovery_counts separates retained/restored/purged; original success history is not rewritten
plans: Risk protected cannot queue. Every entry freezes ID/signature/action; explicit kind/action allowlist and availability, never score/name/actions[0] inference. stop_service requires Running and changes no startup mode. Incomplete dirs disallowed; application entities never path-deduped. Existing simulated skip. Planned catalog revision bound, current identities/actions checked before execute. Plan action_groups count only its frozen batch. No arbitrary path actions or real executor.
privacy: No user file body read for LLM. Metadata only; send_paths false by default. Independent duplicate scan reads candidate bytes locally for SHA-256 but never sends them to a model. No real provider key expected in tests. LLM cannot execute or approve plans.
agent_task: statuses ready/investigating/awaiting_review/executing/needs_input/needs_model/paused/budget_exhausted/error/completed. Configurable per-turn model_requests4..32 and tool_calls6..128 (defaults6/12). Soft remaining-resource guidance retains normal tools until the hard ceiling; checkpoints preserve work for continuation. Output-error recovery alone narrows tools to durable evidence/conclusion. Model record_advice/propose_plan schemas cap6 items; host historical30 and manual500 remain separate. High-rating initialization is an editable draft, never approval; final selection determines targets. Protected/out-of-scope/unsupported identities and stale plans cannot bypass factual checks. Unknown score is not3 or permission. Tool text is untrusted.
action_runtime: simulation backend only. Per-item durable intent plus atomic overlay/receipt, status succeeded/failed/partial/cancelled/unverified. Recovery verifies receipts without blind replay. User undo is separately visible as current_state=undone. Actual reclaimed bytes always zero.
review_selection: Version0.18 removes score-selection panel and per-score buttons from review/myfiles. Exact rating plus one tri-state select-current-filter control uses shared view,parent,query,rating,scope,risk,kind filters across complete rows. Tree is current parent level, navigation-only not selectable. Fetch cursor pages<=500 serially, candidate cap5000 and total logical-rule cap5000; incomplete/oversize/version-error collection leaves old selection atomically unchanged. Tri-state derives from complete candidates and nearest rules; selected roots with child exceptions remain checked+mixed so next click can deselect. Preserve outside-filter explicit rules and child exclusions. Plans freeze<=500 physical targets; remaining draft retained and stale catalog requires recheck. cleanup_auto_select_four lives in Settings cleanup preferences, existing UI-pref API auto-saves/rolls back error independently of model/text settings; eligible5 preselect stays, only new analysis initial drafts change. Current manual choices untouched. Explicit confirmation and simulation-only boundaries unchanged.
dark_surface_refinement: Version0.17.1 only dims dark canvas/card/soft/input/sidebar/interaction and rating/impact background tokens; canvas#090e16,panel#151f2d,soft#1d2b3d. Preserve surface separation, ink/muted/rating foregrounds, typography/layout/text-selection, scoring/action/model/backend semantics and simulation-only boundaries; light/non-dark declarations verified identical to0.17 baseline. Strict Python590,Node165,7JSsyntax passed, detector empty. Actual source dark1280x720/light960x680 no horizontal overflow, sampled explanation/label/rating minimum contrast8.01/5.21. Final EXE scoped native dark review/myfiles inspected and recorded, no UI LLM request or processing action. Original four durable files restored byte-for-byte; normal launch verified with 8 tasks,12 prior advice,18 model requests and identical model settings, not an all-module native claim; version0.17 evidence remains historical.
task_memory: Durable goal, choices, versioned plan, simulation receipts, up to300 historical facts/task with32MiB global fact-payload retention. Separate last_public_reply stores accepted public text<=8000 chars with completed_at,protocol,host provenance,truncated; not private continuation, model context or partial-stream success. Model connection change reconstructs fresh context. Request attempts/tools/work counted; missing provider token usage is unknown.
task_scan: ScanIndex durable name/metadata spool, stable keyset cursor; steps1..512, rows<=100000/scan. Interrupted unfinished enumeration replays with explicit work accounting; acquired rows retained. Whole-directory actions require separate current subtree validation. Investigation offers22 tool schemas; finalization offers record_advice/propose_plan/present_findings/ask_user, last finish-only phase present_findings/ask_user. discover_tools is help, not lazy schema loading.
guidance: 18 fixed bundled markdown resources, version1.3.0, each max32KiB; list_skills/read_skill provide bounded guidance with versions/fingerprints/official sources. Guidance is not current evidence or extra execution permission.
user_actions: Model questions have independent monotonic versions; answers/skip durable but not approval. Host direct-plan preflights current identity in task scope, then same approve/runtime; source, chosen IDs, results flow back. Legacy manual history only intersects task-known IDs for model awareness.
license: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0; Required Notice copyright 2026 Liss. Scope original PanXu material; third-party components retain their licenses. Explicit user choice 2026-11-02.
developer_dock: Closed by default; settings entry and F12 toggle. Same bounded capture/view filters in right-side dock; mounted independently of current task view. No auto capture when opening.
appearance: Default follows system; explicit saved light/dark preserved; live media changes apply without restart.
read_only_evidence: collect_system_configuration(section=memory_power) observes memory/active vs configured pagefiles/power via fixed APIs and7 registry values; inspect_volume(scope_id) observes only existing task-scope volume capacity/recycle statistics. No root or action targets added; unknown/partial explicit.
icons: Private known-ID local icon extraction from existing executable resources, desktop registration or stock/type fallback; visible lazy requests, bounded queues/cache, no shell extensions/shortcut resolution or LLM transmission. Icons do not certify publisher or ownership.
developer_readability: Visible-role text and public communication by default, one closed auxiliary section per event for system/context/facts/skills/tools/metadata/raw sanitized JSON. Protocol-private content stays excluded.
model_streaming: Four native protocols with real SSE aggregation; public cumulative previews independent of developer capture; partial tools never executable; cancel/disconnect/budget fail closed. Defaults on, JSON fallback labelled; spring grapheme UI respects reduced motion. Save precedes fixed-data connection test and failed test never rolls back saved settings.
visual_hierarchy: Version0.17 strengthens comfortable saturation and separation between canvas/cards/inner advice surfaces. Platform Chinese page/section/lead/body/label/meta roles reference30/20/18/15/14/13px, implemented in rem (page30px=1.875rem), main leading1.75 and advice body1.65; preserve light/dark/system identity. Full purpose/suggestion/reason/impact remain directly readable; normal body ink stays stable, suggestion follows cleanup inclination and independent impact background follows its own rating, unknown/stale neutral. No extra impact number/scale/control, content truncation, navigation step, model input or execution authority. Strict Python590 full rerun and Node165 passed; actual source dark1280x720/light960x680 no horizontal overflow, sampled explanation/label minimum contrast6.30/5.21 respectively. Initial local HTTP10053 failure and rerun evidence retained. Final EXE scoped native text-selection/copy checks passed; original four durable profile files restored byte-for-byte and normal launch verified with 8 tasks, 12 prior advice and 18 model requests unchanged; source samples do not certify all controls/zoom/assistive modes or reuse older artifact results.
rating_presentation: Shared badges across task review/files/inventory/Inspector/developer advice show five segments plus semantic text, without visible numerator/denominator or redundant4/5. Version0.17 uses teal/cyan-blue/neutral-blue-gray/gold-brown/soft-berry-coral with coordinated distinct surfaces rather than uniformly pale treatment; active segment count retains ordinal value. Colors classify cleanup inclination, never safety/danger/success or permission. Actual numeric value stays in ARIA/title and numeric filters/bulk controls/preferences. Visible inherited marker and accessible provenance/non-individual-analysis distinction remain; unanalysed/unrated/skipped/no_advice have distinct text and no filled score scale. Stale overrides old rating foreground/surface to neutral and identifies the old value accessibly. Persisted score, selection/action/scope/protection/500-batch and simulation-only rules unchanged; source regression/page checks and scoped final EXE native checks passed; original four durable profile files restored byte-for-byte and normal launch verified with 8 tasks, 12 prior advice and 18 model requests unchanged.
text_selection: Version0.17 explicitly enables pywebview text_select=True for main/already-open notice windows; CSS allows useful readable text selection while preserving control behavior. Normal system Ctrl+C, no added copy buttons, clipboard read/write APIs or permission. PanxuTextSelection suppresses click/default only for a new nonempty selection on the same file-name-button/label/summary interaction; old selection, keyboard detail0, checkbox/input, different target and ordinary buttons remain unaffected. Install once, no copy/keydown listener, safe fallback without Selection API. Selecting/copying never starts analysis, changes task checkbox state, approves a plan or executes an operation. Native-parameter mocks/DOM regressions passed and source computed body/name styles allow text selection; final EXE native paragraph/filename drag selection and Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V verified, filename drag stayed in review without opening details. Other label/summary cases remain DOM-regression scope, original four durable profile files restored byte-for-byte and normal launch verified with 8 tasks, 12 prior advice and 18 model requests unchanged.
subtitle: AI 磁盘清理助手
author: Liss
advice_provenance: Optional host-owned {source:llm|local|unknown,provider,model,protocol,generated_at}; generated_at is timezone-aware UTC accepted output time, actual request snapshot, no endpoint/key. Missing history normalizes to unknown with null identities/time. Task advice and plan/item persist separately; matching old advice may appear as item.advice_provenance; user_direct uses local metadata and plan.origin. Changing settings never re-labels prior records.
assessment: Optional ordinal cleanup_rating:int1..5|null;3 neutral, missing never3. Independent optional impact_rating:int1..5|null describes operation consequence magnitude, never inferred from cleanup_rating/risk/text and never selection/permission input. record_advice conclusion recommend|review|keep|skip|no_advice, inheritance:none|subtree(default none, directory content only). Shared monotonic host index bound to item signature; newer task intent blocks late older responses. Explicit child/barrier wins. Inherited score/context/provenance grants no action or authorization. Model-origin/automatic full-directory selection respects specific advisory and coverage barriers. Final user_direct may select low/skipped/unrated/stale-advice items or override task temporary keep/defer, but never signature staleness, policy protection, unsupported action, scope or incomplete whole-directory validation; containers with specific advisory barriers are expanded. Old per-task history retained.
impact_rating: Version0.16 optional strict integer1..5|null in advice/assessment and frozen plan entries:1 very small,2 slight,3 noticeable,4 substantial,5 major or hard to reverse; consequence magnitude, not likelihood or cleanup preference. Missing legacy/invalid or stale is unknown, never midpoint or inferred. Ordinary inventory uses corresponding assessment; direct frozen action renders its top-level impact text and impact_rating as a pair, never borrows an older assessment value. Only primary impact-block background changes from cool-neutral to soft warm-gray; text remains ordinary ink and full impact stays readable. No visible new number/scale/control, optional exact ARIA/title and readable developer value. Does not affect cleanup_rating, selection, scope, action, protection, confirmation, runtime or actual reclaimed bytes.
timestamps: details.timestamps:created_at from st_birthtime_ns only,modified_at,accessed_at,observed_at timezone-aware ISO or null,scope entry_only; ordinary LLM metadata omits access, detailed shows caveat. ctime/signature semantics unchanged. Age, size, RSS are weak context, not deterministic score or actual-use history.
briefing: Optional propose_plan/present_findings briefing:{highlights?:string[<=3],cautions?:string[<=2],coverage?:string[<=2]}, each point<=160 chars. Summary remains propose_plan<=600/present_findings<=1000 chars whether briefing is present or absent; no hidden cross-field160-char rejection. Around80-char summary is style guidance only. Main-list preview<=160 is presentation, full accepted summary persists and remains readable in analysis details. Host-owned briefing_provenance binds accepted text to original task/plan version. Other schema,coverage,identity,scope and approval rules unchanged; no action authorization from presentation.
prompt_budget: Version0.16 unifies all analysis entry points as on-demand: no initial_objects or small-target-full/large-target-sample first-request branch, and no automatic target adoption. Goal, explicit boundaries and necessary state remain; existing tools retrieve objects/details as needed. Host-generated context and complete tool results use readable indented PanXu data v1 after privacy filtering. Only explicitly marked host projections omit determined duplicate role/time/connection/default-empty shells and repeated observation/bookkeeping echoes; persisted task/facts remain complete. Context facts are bounded references/tool names, read_facts recovers original content/time/scope/recheck requirements; legacy observations without retained facts are not silently dropped. Preserve meaningful IDs, signatures, cursors, boundaries, unknown/zero/false/partial. Normal native call/results remain paired and protocol typed;22 schemas, user/assistant prose and private continuation are not rewritten. No permission/scope expansion or unbounded budget. Report model-visible chars separately from HTTP bytes; heuristic estimates are not provider token usage.
usage_evidence: Version0.16: one bounded read-only current-HKCU UserAssist acquisition per collect_apps inventory; list/inspect reuse that snapshot, no new monitor/service/sampling. Local normalized absolute executable references match by digest only, never basename/fuzzy/product name. Process executable, explicit startup executable and explicit software DisplayIcon references carry distinct match_type; wrappers/launchers/uninstallers, ambiguous/shared registration refs, unsupported format, missing source/permission/no match remain unknown, partial coverage explicit. Service has no GUI-use evidence; software reference is not whole-app usage or proof of main executable. program_facts.usage_evidence allowlists source/status/match_type/last_recorded_launch_at/cumulative_launch_count/coverage/reason; no raw registry names/values/commands/executable digests/app-history list sent. Counter start/reset/window unknown: no frequency_per_30_days, no-record is not unused, multiple counters not blindly summed. Existing version/publisher/install scope metadata is allowlisted/privacy-filtered, not publisher authentication. Process start/RSS remain distinct from usage; evidence assists model reasoning without deterministic age/count scoring, automatic selection or operation authority.
selection_batch: {ids,snapshots,items:[{id,name,kind,path,signature,action,action_label,action_effect,category,assessment:{state,rating}}],action_groups:[{action,label,total,returned}],revision,catalog_revision,selection_revision,task_id,counts,groups,has_more,next_cursor,requires_batches,offset,limit,observed_only:true}; <=500 targets per response: file directory coalescing only, app exact IDs stay distinct. counts.total_targets/action_groups.total cover full selection; returned covers current batch, unlike plan.action_groups which describes only frozen plan. Rating groups include1..5/skipped/unrated/no_advice even zero. Cursor binds task intent/filter/kind/rules/revisions. <=5000 explicit IDs; whole-directory targets may represent many files, partial/unscanned/outside-task content never presumed selected/empty.
